app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

title.example: 1983 TOPPS BASEBALL - 1952 TOPPS REPRINTS #311 MICKEY MANTLE

description.example: Brand NEW & Open Box Milwaukee tools, batteries, and bundles!

title.example: Jules' Tools - Milwaukee, DeWALT, Ryobi Power TOOLS!!!

concurrent_viewer_count.description:
ConcurrentViewerCount is the live viewer count at the time of the
request. Zero for streams that are not currently LIVE.

description.example: Brand NEW & Open Box Milwaukee tools, batteries, and bundles!

title.example: Jules' Tools - Milwaukee, DeWALT, Ryobi Power TOOLS!!!

feedback_positive_count.description:
Feedback* / *Rating fields are only populated by Service.GetLiveStream
(single-stream detail); Service.ListLiveStreams' hub feed does not
request this data, so these are zero/omitted there. All scores are
scoped to the seller's last 365 days of feedback.

auction_status.description:
Auction* fields reflect the live bidding state and are only meaningful
for saleType Auction. AuctionStatus is one of READY (queued, not yet
started), LIVE (actively taking bids), or ENDED.

is_exclusive.description:
IsExclusive/Purchasable reflect eBay Live's own commerce-signal flags
for this listing (e.g. whether it can be bought outright vs. only won
via the live auction).

title.example: #001 - Tool ONLY - Unless Specified! - Watch Auction

streams.description:
Streams preserves the order returned by upstream, which is not
guaranteed to match the requested id order. An id that does not
resolve to a real event is silently omitted -- confirmed live that
upstream returns 200 with a shorter events array rather than an error
for unknown ids, matching the plural-lookup semantics of a batch
endpoint rather than the single-id GetLiveStream's typed 404.

next_request_number.description:
NextRequestNumber and SessionID feed back into a follow-up call's
request_number/session_id to fetch the next page.

title.example: 1983 TOPPS BASEBALL - 1952 TOPPS REPRINTS #311 MICKEY MANTLE

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Returns normalized details for a public eBay item listing.

parameters.name: category

parameters.name: ids

get.description: Returns normalized detail for a single eBay Live stream/event, including each host's feedback summary for the last 365 days.
Returns the currently featured/auction items for an eBay Live stream, including live bidding state.

get.description: Returns normalized details for a public eBay seller profile.
Returns normalized seller about information from the public eBay store about tab, including seller stats, top-rated status, optional location/member-since fields, and cleaned store categories.
Returns normalized seller feedback summary, detailed ratings, and recent review cards from the public eBay seller feedback tab.
